purpose: Application entry point: enforces single-instance via named Mutex, wires up global exception handlers, and starts the WinForms message loop with TrayAppContext.
calls_out_to: DeletionHelper.TryRunCleanupFromCommandLine — exits early if invoked as cleanup helper
invariants: A second instance detects the named Mutex as already owned and exits immediately without creating a tray icon or hooks
All unhandled UI-thread exceptions show a MessageBox and call Environment.Exit(1)
Application.SetHighDpiMode(SystemAware) is called before any UI is created
gotchas: DeletionHelper.TryRunCleanupFromCommandLine is checked BEFORE the single-instance mutex — cleanup children must be allowed to run even if a parent instance is already running
AppDomain.UnhandledException handles non-UI thread crashes (logs only; no message box since the thread may not support it)
